name: Toll Seal of the Nine Bends (Cửu Khúc Quan Ấn)
lore: The bronze seal the ferry master stamps on every pass at the nine landings, cut in 790 when the boat families became one gate (A075). The Ferry War began over what it stamped (C192). Giang Cửu Khúc has carried it since 1010 and uses it in a fight as a hand seal; he says everybody pays in the end.
build_use: The head's toll: Water damage, a linh lực tithe from the foe, and less damage once it has paid.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: The Last White Sail (Bạch Phàm Kỳ)
effects: The Boat That Did Not Burn
lore: The sail of the one ferry that did not burn at the Đào Sa landing in 1173 (A080), because Thương Bạch Phàm cut it loose and poled it into the current with nine children aboard. She had it made into a war flag when the fleet was rebuilt with the pines' timber in 1175, and plants it on the landing every spring.
build_use: The boat-mistress's Flag charge: defence, evasion and fire protection for her.

name: Anchor of the First Fleet (Sơ Hạm Mao)
lore: The bronze anchor of the founder's own ferry, the first boat of the joined families in 790. It rode out the burning of 1173 on the river bed and was hauled up for the rebuilt fleet.
build_use: The ferryman's blow: Water damage that arrives with weight.

name: Ferry Master's Oilskin (Độ Chủ Du Giáp)
lore: Oiled sharkskin over river-reed scale, the coat a ferry master wears at the spring flood. Thương Bạch Phàm sewed this one for him after the Ferry War.
build_use: A ferryman's body that goes round a blow.
